title: Crafted Spawners
description: This simple datapack adds a recipe for the spawner and all basics mobs eggs !
body:
_**Crafted Spawners lets you create spawners using creature eggs and ores.**_

### How it works:

There are three egg rarities: **basic**, **rare**, and **epic**.

For each egg, you'll need a corresponding ore block: **copper**, **gold**, or **diamond**.

_The rarity of the eggs depends on the usefulness of the items dropped by the mob._

### Available Eggs:

**Basic:** _Zombie, Spider, Slime_

**Rare:** _Sheep, Pig, Chicken, Skeleton_

**Epic:** _Cow, Creeper, Pillager, Iron Golem_

### Datapack Updates:
If this datapack reaches **100 downloads**, new creatures will be added!

💡**Recipes:** All recipes are available in the datapack gallery.
